title: Nonasymptotic CLT and Error Bounds for Linear Two-Time-Scale Stochastic Approximation
abstract: arXiv:2502.09884v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We consider linear two-time-scale stochastic approximation algorithms driven by martingale noise. Recent applications in machine learning motivate the need to understand finite-time error rates, but conventional stochastic approximation analyses focus on either asymptotic convergence in distribution or finite-time bounds that are far from optimal. Prior work on asymptotic central limit theorems (CLTs) suggests that two-time-scale algorithms may be able to achieve $1/\sqrt{K}$ error in expectation, with a constant given by the expected norm of the limiting Gaussian vector. However, the best known finite-time rates are much slower. We derive the first nonasymptotic Wasserstein-1 CLT for linear two-time-scale stochastic approximation with Polyak-Ruppert averaging driven by martingale difference noise. translated_title: 线性双时间尺度随机逼近的非渐近中心极限定理与误差界
translated_abstract: 我们研究由鞅噪声驱动的线性双时间尺度随机逼近算法。机器学习中的最新应用促使人们需要理解有限时间误差率，但传统的随机逼近分析要么关注分布意义上的渐近收敛，要么给出远非最优的有限时间界。先前关于渐近中心极限定理（CLT）的工作表明，双时间尺度算法可能能够在期望意义下达到 $1/\sqrt{K}$ 的误差，其常数由极限高斯向量的期望范数给出；然而，目前已知最好的有限时间速率要慢得多。我们推导了首个针对由鞅差噪声驱动、采用 Polyak-Ruppert 平均的线性双时间尺度随机逼近的非渐近 Wasserstein-1 中心极限定理。作为推论，我们证明 Polyak-Ruppert 平均所达到的期望误差以 $1/\sqrt{K}$ 的速率衰减，这一结果显著……
tldr: 本文首次建立了带 Polyak-Ruppert 平均的线性双时间尺度随机逼近的非渐近 Wasserstein-1 中心极限定理，并由此证明其期望误差以最优的 1/√K 速率衰减，填补了有限时间分析与渐近理论之间的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the first nonasymptotic Wasserstein-1 CLT for linear two-time-scale stochastic approximation with Polyak-Ruppert averaging under martingale difference noise, proving that the expected error decays at the optimal 1/√K rate.
